82556a8914f02048624316d058e9a62b8a74845c.message:
queue: retry with jittered backoff

Retries from many workers used to line up on the same second. Grow the
delay exponentially from a base and add up to 25% random jitter.

65a3e23a62988e440ba923ae5b31c31b6c5aa1a3.message:
queue: fix lost wakeup in worker shutdown

A worker that was between select and run missed the cancel and kept
running for one more job. Check ctx.Err before taking the next job.
65a3e23a62988e440ba923ae5b31c31b6c5aa1a3.diff:
diff --git a/internal/queue/worker.go b/internal/queue/worker.go
index 3f2a1c4..8b7d9e0 100644
--- a/internal/queue/worker.go
+++ b/internal/queue/worker.go
@@ -52,6 +52,9 @@ func (w *worker) loop(ctx context.Context) {
 		case j := <-w.jobs:
+			if ctx.Err() != nil {
+				w.q.release(j)
+				return
+			}
 			w.run(ctx, j)

18d8996390893209563f5601e776ac94b0b9cb34.message:
docs: describe the dedupe design

Explain why dedupe keys are scoped to a queue and how long they live.
18d8996390893209563f5601e776ac94b0b9cb34.diff:
diff --git a/docs/dedupe.md b/docs/dedupe.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8b7d9e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/dedupe.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Dedupe
+
+A job may carry a key. While a job with the same key is pending,
+later submissions with that key are dropped.
+
+Keys are scoped to a single queue and forgotten once the job
+finishes, fails for good, or expires.

9885728079ad665f527f04201a9ef6a65bc53b1f.message:
queue: add visibility timeout to leases

A leased job now reappears after the visibility timeout instead of
waiting for the sweeper, which made recovery take up to a minute.

8e4745307775204aadacd1ad4367eac4fb9c0d74.message:
ci: cache the Go build in actions

Cuts the median CI run from 4m10s to 1m50s.

diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 3f2a1c4..8b7d9e0 100644

+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -9,6 +9,12 @@ jobs:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
       - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
+        with:
+          go-version-file: go.mod
+          cache: true
       - run: go build ./...
       - run: go test -race ./...

f211835fe32e64143e92f898803f10b14f83259e.message:
cmd: add tidepool drain subcommand

tidepool drain waits for in-flight jobs and exits non-zero on timeout.
f211835fe32e64143e92f898803f10b14f83259e.diff:
diff --git a/cmd/tidepool/drain.go b/cmd/tidepool/drain.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8b7d9e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cmd/tidepool/drain.go
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+package main
+
+import "time"
+
+func drain(q *queue.Queue, d time.Duration) error {
+	if err := q.Drain(d); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("drain: %w", err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

9d70c3bc638a7bc0017b5a5f23981e6999aea9b4.message:
queue: stop double-delivering expired leases

The sweeper and a worker could both pick up a job whose lease had just
expired. Take the job lock before re-enqueueing.
